text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Damn it...!
I was so close, too!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, I gave it my all.
But I still could've done more...!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: How... strange.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Until now, I would've thought 'I knew it...' and hung my head in despair, but...

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
It's different now.
I believe that I can use this for next time.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: I... must have gotten stronger, haven't I?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: —Nature, great job out there.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
McQueen,
Ryan-senpai...!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
"Competing against you
has taught me so much as well."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
I felt Nature-chan's full power
loud and clear!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Let's run together again!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Yes!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: —I look forward to working with you!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Those two were so refreshing right to the end.
They were already looking ahead.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: "No matter the result, she's already looking to the next. Always reaching forward for what lies ahead."

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: ...Teio was the same. That's why she's so strong.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Until now, I'd put limits on myself. Thinking no matter how hard I tried, this was as far as I could go.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
3rd place, exactly.
Deep down, I gave up... thinking I couldn't go any further.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Still, that wasn't enough.
If I wanted to reach the light, I had to keep on believing.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
If this third place came from aiming straight for first,
then surely... it will lead to the next victory.

Nice Nature is looking forward, too.
Even when competing on the biggest stages,
she won't shy away anymore.
"To that race, where she can gain even more confidence and prestige...!"
choice_data_list: Why don't we run in the Tenno Sho (Autumn) next?
Why don't we run in the Tenno Sho (Autumn) next?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: The Tenno Sho (Autumn)...!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
The historic and traditional "Tenno Sho."
Me, in a race like that...?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
...No, no, no.
Why are you getting so timid?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
"It's not 'I wonder if it's okay to run'... 
I have to psych myself up and say, 'I AM running!'"

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Let's dive in.
Into the grand autumn stage...!
—And so, it was decided that we would take on the Tenno Sho (Autumn) to determine the strongest middle-distance runner!
